name: The United Laboratories International Holdings Limited
summary: The United Laboratories International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the research and development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of pharmaceutical products. It operates through three segments: Bulk Medicine, Intermediate Products, and Finished Products. The company offers amoxicillin products; insulin series, antibiotics, and ophthalmic products; and veterinary drugs. It also provides 6-aminopenicillanic acid and penicillin G potassium products.
